name: browser-use
headline: Explore agent-skills for automation
short_description: Agent Skills is a directory and explorer for AI agent skills. It indexes skill repositories, lets you browse and preview SKILL.md instructions, and supports downloading a complete skill folder for local use. Operations teams can quickly find and deploy skills to automate workflows.
author: futantan

sections.overview:
Agent Skills is a directory and explorer that indexes skill repositories and lets you browse SKILL.md instructions before downloading complete skill folders for local use. It provides a centralized platform where operations teams can quickly discover and deploy AI agent skills to automate workflows. The tool supports skill exploration through an intuitive interface that previews skill documentation and enables direct downloads. Built on Next.js, React, and TypeScript, it uses PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM for reliable skill indexing and retrieval.
Finding and deploying pre-built AI skills for workflow automation
Browsing skill repositories and previewing SKILL.md instructions
Downloading complete skill folders for local integration
Centralizing skill discovery for operations teams
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/futantan/agent-skills.md`
sections.usage:
```
Use the Agent Skills directory to find and deploy automation skills for [SPECIFIC WORKFLOW]. Search for skills tagged with [KEYWORDS] like 'data processing', 'report generation', or 'API integration'. Preview the SKILL.md instructions for [SKILL_NAME], then download the skill folder for local deployment. Test the skill in a staging environment before rolling it out to production.
```
Copy

```
After searching the Agent Skills directory for skills tagged with 'data processing' and 'API integration', I found the 'CSV-to-SQL-Transformer' skill. The SKILL.md preview showed it automates converting CSV files into SQL insert statements with customizable table schemas. The skill folder included a Python script, a README with setup instructions, and a sample CSV file for testing.

I downloaded the folder and ran the setup in a Python virtual environment using `pip install -r requirements.txt`. The script processed a 50MB sales_data.csv file in under 2 minutes, generating 12,450 SQL insert statements. The output was validated against a staging PostgreSQL database, confirming all records were inserted correctly with no duplicates.

The skill’s README recommended using it in CI/CD pipelines for ETL processes, which aligns with our team’s workflow for nightly data warehouse updates. I scheduled the skill to run automatically at 2 AM via a GitHub Actions workflow, replacing our manual Python script that previously took 30 minutes to process the same file.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
